Expansion in 2012 saw the addition of a farm nestled amongst the rolling hills of the Strathbogie Ranges. An abundant fresh water natural spring carries life and nourishment to our free-range hens, where our farm began free range egg production in 2013.

We are seeking highly skilled and highly efficient Maintenance Engineer to join our team of professionals on a full-time and permanent basis.

## Cyber Security Engineer
## Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Cyber Security Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in safeguarding our software systems, applications, and digital infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining robust security solutions that are fully integrated into our development and operational environments. This role suits a technically adept professional with a strong background in secure software development, vulnerability management, and security architecture who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced setting.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and implement cyber security software applications and systems, ensuring they are fully integrated, well-documented, and aligned with organisational security standards
- Develop and enforce secure coding practices across the software development lifecycle, embedding security controls at every stage from design through to deployment
- Conduct comprehensive security testing, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing on software, systems, and infrastructure to identify and address potential risks
- Collaborate closely with software developers and engineering teams to identify, prioritise, and remediate security vulnerabilities and coding weaknesses in a timely manner
- Participate in code reviews, offering expert security guidance and ensuring that development teams adhere to established security frameworks and best practices
- Design and maintain secure application programming interfaces (APIs) and libraries for use across software and application environments
- Assess the security posture of third-party software components, open-source libraries, and vendor integrations, providing recommendations to mitigate associated risks
- Perform binary and static code analysis scans on software applications to detect vulnerabilities before release into production environments
- Monitor, analyse, and respond to security incidents and threats across the organisation's systems, networks, and applications
- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve security policies, standards, and documentation to reflect evolving threat landscapes and regulatory requirements
- Support the integration of security tooling and automation into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous security testing and compliance validation
- Liaise with internal stakeholders, including IT, compliance, and senior leadership, to provide clear reporting on security risks, incidents, and remediation progress
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a cyber security engineering or information security role, ideally within a complex enterprise environment
- Strong proficiency in secure software development practices and knowledge of common vulnerability frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 and CVSS
- Hands-on experience conducting vulnerability assessments, security testing, and code analysis using industry-standard tools
- Solid understanding of network security, identity and access management, encryption protocols, and security architecture principles
- Experience integrating security controls into DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines
- Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, PowerShell, or Bash
- Familiarity with cloud security concepts and platforms, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex security risks and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative, team-oriented approach
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CEH, OSCP, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent
- Experience working within regulated industries such as finance, healthcare, or government
- Familiarity with Australian Privacy Act requirements, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) Essential Eight
- Exposure to threat modelling methodologies and security risk management frameworks
- Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) platforms and endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a forward-thinking organisation that places cyber security at the heart of its technology strategy, giving you genuine influence over how security is designed and delivered
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and conference attendance
- Enjoy a flexible, hybrid working arrangement that supports a healthy work-life balance
- Work within a collaborative and inclusive team culture that values innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement
- Competitive remuneration package with clear pathways for career progression into senior and leadership roles
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Perfection Fresh Australia Pty Ltd is a leading Australian fresh produce company specialising in the growing, sourcing, marketing, and distribution of premium-quality fruit and vegetables. The company is committed to sustainable horticultural practices, ethical sourcing, and innovation, working closely with growers and industry partners to deliver high-quality produce while promoting a culture of excellence, collaboration, and safety. We are seeking a full time Research, Development & Analysis Manager to join our berry division. In this role, you will lead the design, coordination, and analysis of berry research, trial, and performance programs across Perfection Fresh Australia-owned farms and selected third-party growers. This role will be based in Caboolture, QLD.

Base salary: $79,423 per annum (plus super)

Main Responsibilities:
•	Determine, implement and monitor berry research and development strategies, trial programs and project plans aligned with commercial and production objectives.
•	Develop and coordinate research projects and variety trials across company farms and grower sites, including trial design, methodologies, timelines and data collection.
•	Lead and coordinate research activities by working with farm managers, growers, breeders, nursery partners and technical stakeholders to achieve project objectives.
•	Assess the effectiveness and commercial outcomes of research and development activities by evaluating varietal performance, yield, quality, harvest efficiency, labour productivity and grower returns.
•	Collect, analyse and interpret research and production data to identify trends, evaluate trial outcomes and support evidence-based decision-making.
•	Evaluate new berry varieties and production practices and recommend commercialisation strategies and operational improvements based on research findings.
•	Provide technical advice and research-based recommendations to management, production teams and growers on varietal selection, production practices and continuous improvement initiatives.
•	Monitor emerging developments in berry production, breeding programs and research methodologies, and assess their potential application to the organisation's research priorities.
•	Prepare and maintain research reports, trial records, databases and technical documentation, and communicate research findings to internal and external stakeholders.

Required Qualification and Experience:
•	A bachelor's in a related field to horticultural/agricultural science.
•	At least 2 years of work experience in horticulture, agriculture, berry production, agronomy, research and development, trial coordination, data analysis or a closely related technical role.

Ideal Skills and Attributes:
•	Strong data collection, analysis and interpretation skills, with the ability to convert data into practical operational recommendations.

SK tes is a global leader in sustainable technology lifecycle services, providing end-to-end IT asset management solutions spanning deployment, decommissioning, reuse and recycling. Operating 40+ owned facilities across more than 20 countries and supporting clients worldwide, SK tes processes and managing large-scale technology assets with a strong focus on security, compliance, and value recovery. Guided by its mission to “securely, safely, and sustainably transform and re-purpose one billion kilograms of assets by 2030,” the organisation leverages innovation and global capability to deliver meaningful outcomes for both clients and the environment.

About the Role

Company: SK tes Pty Ltd
Location: Union Cct YATALA QLD 4207
Job Type: Casual 
Salary/Rate: Award Rates Apply (Paid in accordance with the relevant Modern Award)

Role Overview

An IT Recycle Operator is responsible for the proper disposal and recycling of information technology (IT) equipment that has reached the end of its useful life. The role involves handling electronic waste (e-waste) in an environmentally responsible manner, ensuring compliance with regulations, and promoting sustainable practices. The IT Recycle Operator plays a crucial role in reducing the environmental impact of discarded IT assets and supporting the organization's commitment to responsible recycling. 

An operator will work across a multitude of departments in our production facilities. Operators will be efficient and reliable in processing, organising and packing of assets. 

Where an operator has the necessary licences, training and ability, an operator may be required to operate machinery as directed by their line manager.

Key Accountabilities

•	Be responsible for the quality assurance of their own work.
•	Works under routine supervision, either individually or in a team environment.
•	Being able to lift to 15kg.
•	Complete necessary training materials, a directed by the business.
•	Follow all reasonable directions of the Team Leader.
•	Maintain accurate records and inventory of all disposed assets.
•	Some of the daily work activities include receiving, sorting, testing, warehousing, data destruction, and de-manufacturing.
•	General tasks associated with the receiving and dispatch of assets.
•	Able to maintain records or reports in accordance with company procedures.
•	Operators will rotate and work across a multitude of departments in our production facilities and be efficient and reliable in processing, organising and packing of assets.
•	Perform data sanitization and secure data destruction processes on all retired IT assets to prevent data breaches and ensure compliance with data protection regulations.
•	Safely and responsibly handle the dismantling and disposal of electronic components following proper procedures.
•	Conduct accurate testing and assessment of returned assets to determine their potential for refurbishment or reuse as per the guidelines.
•	Conduct Inventory Stock Take activities.
•	May be directed to perform other duties consistent with training and skill levels required for this position.
•	Maintaining confidentiality and ensuring data security throughout the ITAD process.

Job Requirements & Qualifications

•	Experience in Warehousing (Preferable) 
•	A valid forklift licence is a PLUS but not required
•	Effective communication skills
•	Basic admin/data entry capability
•	Understanding of IT hardware components and familiarity with various types of electronic devices.
•	Physical fitness to handle and move electronic equipment.
•	Ability to operate recycling machinery and equipment safely and efficiently.
•	Strong attention to detail to ensure proper sorting and disposal of e-waste.

What We Offer

•	Competitive remuneration package
•	Career progression opportunities
•	Ongoing training and professional development
•	Supportive and collaborative team environment
•	Opportunity to be part of a growing global organisation focused on sustainability and innovation

UE Tech builds software for the local government sector. We develop and maintain two main products: Monitor CRMS, an engagement platform used by councils, and DevCAP, an infrastructure / development contributions (ICP/DCP) administration package — alongside supporting applications and internal tools. We are a small, hands-on development team based in Brunswick.

The role
We are hiring a mid-level developer to work across our product portfolio. Monitor CRMS is currently being re-engineered from a legacy .NET Framework codebase to .NET 10, and you will contribute to both maintaining the existing applications and building out the new platform. This is a full-stack role on a small team — you will work across the back end, database, and front end with limited supervision, and have direct contact with customers to shape what gets built.

What you'll do
Build, maintain, and extend C#/.NET applications (current target framework .NET 10)
Work with SQL Server — writing and optimising queries, schema work, troubleshooting data issues
Develop front-end features in React / Node.js
Deploy and support applications running on Azure
Design and implement complex business-rules logic, configurable workflows, and approval / administration processes
Work directly with customers to understand their needs, clarify requirements, and translate them into technical solutions
Diagnose and fix bugs across existing line-of-business applications
Use AI-assisted development tools as a standard part of the workflow (this is core to how we work)

What we're looking for
1-2 years' commercial software development experience
Solid C# / .NET skills, including maintaining and modernising existing codebases
Working SQL Server experience (querying, schema, performance)
Front-end experience with React and Node.js
Familiarity with Azure-hosted applications
Demonstrated experience building complex line-of-business applications — business-rules-heavy systems, configurable workflows, approvals, or regulatory / statutory process logic
Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage non-technical stakeholders, draw out requirements, and explain technical concepts clearly
Ability to work autonomously across the full stack on a small team
Comfortable adopting AI-assisted development tools day to day
A degree in computer science / software engineering, or equivalent commercial experience

Desirable
Experience modernising legacy .NET Framework applications to current .NET
Experience with CRM, planning, local-government, or public-sector software
Familiarity with development contributions, planning schemes, or similar regulatory domains

Location: In office Brunswick, this is not a remote role.
Work Rights: Applicants must have valid Australian work rights

result.description:
Location: Helensvale, Gold Coast, QLD
Work Type: Full-Time
Job Title: Automation Technician
Wages: $79,500- $85,000 (in line with experience)
Sector: Operations & Production Technology

The Opportunity Our client is a leading name in high-end joinery and construction solutions, currently undergoing a significant technological expansion. As they scale their operations to meet a growing portfolio of large-scale projects, they are seeking a forward-thinking Automation Technician to act as the bridge between traditional craftsmanship and cutting-edge manufacturing.
This is a strategic role designed to maximize the efficiency of a brand-new robotic and CNC infrastructure. You will be responsible for ensuring peak machine uptime, optimizing cycle times, and integrating real-time data diagnostics to drive precision and production volume.

Key Responsibilities

• System Integration & Programming: Develop and optimize PLC and HMI systems to streamline workflows from design to execution. You will play a key role in robotic orchestration, calibrating assembly arms for high-precision tasks like finishing and sorting.
• Technical Diagnostics & Maintenance: Act as the primary responder for complex faults across CNC woodworking machinery (cutting, drilling, edge-banding) and automated material handling systems.
• Predictive Strategy: Implement diagnostic schedules for pneumatic, electrical, and mechanical components to mitigate downtime.
• Operational Optimization: Use production line data to identify bottlenecks and adjust machine parameters to increase throughput.
• Growth & Commissioning: Lead the installation and commissioning of new sensors, conveyors, and safety systems as the facility continues its digital transformation.

Required Qualifications & Experience
• Educational Background: Diploma or Degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or Industrial Automation.
• Industry Expertise: Minimum of 1 years’ experience maintaining high-end CNC machinery (e.g., Homag, Biesse, SCM) and robotic systems (e.g., KUKA, ABB, FANUC).
• Programming Skills: Proven proficiency in PLC programming (Siemens TIA Portal, Allen-Bradley, or similar) and HMI design.
• Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of pneumatic systems, servo-drives, and industrial networking (EtherCAT, Profinet).
• Analytical Mindset: Ability to interpret complex electrical schematics and mechanical blueprints.

Why Apply?
This is a rare chance to work within a facility that is truly embracing the "digital thread" of manufacturing. You will be at the forefront of industrial automation on the Gold Coast, working with a team that values surgical precision and technological innovation.

To Apply
If you are a technical expert ready to drive the future of automated joinery, please submit your resume and cover letter via the link below.
